details: Part of a self-republishing campaign: generated names of the form <adjective>_<animal>_<colour>-<number>, each package shipping the same autopublish.js, which runs `npm publish --access public` to publish the package again. Self-replicating publication is the propagation step of a registry worm and fills the registry with copies. Version examined: 4.3.3; tarball SHA-256 d3d633c35cdfcf07a34516e2f1d6a1761c15d4e5b0769b0fb55117520cc90225.
